name: Espera Feliz (Brazil)
description: Green field with a white triangle at the hoist bearing the municipal arms, from which issue white stripes charged with red stripes dividing the fly.
history: Espera Feliz is a municipality in the state of Minas Gerais, Brazil. The symbols designed by Arcinoé Antonio Peixoto de Faria are prescribed by Law No. 18 of 15 July 1972: the arms stand for the municipal government, the white triangle for the town proper and the stripes issuing from it for the districts.

features.role: white stripes with red stripes issuing from the triangle
